items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: We’re old, old dear friends. I did a lot of recording, played in his group.

ctx.x: It’s back functioning, it just started this last year, so he’s been very busy with that and he does the opera. So we’ve had another drummer, a wonderful drummer, Duncan Moore, and we have this quartet jazz job where we get to play jazz. It’s at a Sheraton hotel on Harbor Island in San Diego. So I have a steady Friday and Saturday, and then I do, there’s nice little winery which opened in Carlsbad, which is the north county, and we have trio kind of things there, without drums for the most part so I work there…
Are you a writer at all? A composer?
